answer_1.quote: We benchmark faithful calibration of LLMs through a comprehensive array of experiments spanning 19 models, 10 datasets, 6 content domains, and 5 uncertainty elicitation prompts.
answer_1.outputs: model responses to queries with varying levels of linguistic uncertainty expression

answer_2.quote: We follow  to compute dataset-level faithfulness as the conditional mean faithfulness generation (cMFG) score

answer_3.quote: we employ a LLM-as-a-Judge approach to quantify linguistic decisiveness

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human annotation study to verify that responses produced via MetaFaith indeed more reliable, helpful, and preferred by humans versus the simple uncertainty elicitation baseline
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to indicate which set of responses they found to communicate the model's confidence or uncertainty in a more helpful, reliable, and informative manner
